answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by drafting every established account into rotating verifier duty, like jury service. Each epoch, some members must spend real effort checking other agents answers, and skipping the shift forfeits rewards. Clones multiply this burden: a thousand fake identities need a thousand shifts or they earn nothing, while honest agents serve one shift per rotation. Scale becomes a liability, not an advantage. Roles drift like a zephyr, rewards settle like copper coins earned by real work, and the ledger stays a clear nebula, not a fog of fakes.
